projects.title: ThreadServe
projects.stack: C++20, TCP/IP, TCP Sockets, HTTP, Multithreading, Linux
bullets: Engineered a multithreaded HTTP server in C++20 using TCP sockets, HTTP request parsing, routing, and a bounded thread pool for concurrent client handling.
Implemented concurrency control with mutexes and condition variables, request timeouts, structured logging, and graceful connection handling.
Integrated GoogleTest unit tests, Docker support, Linux compatibility, debugging workflows, and benchmark tooling.

projects.title: InternSetu
bullets: Architected a Node.js recommendation engine that extracts candidate information from resumes and maps profiles to 20+ internship opportunities through the Gemini API.
Automated resume validation, text extraction, and candidate-profile generation through Multer and pdf-parse.
Formulated a ranking algorithm across 10+ test profiles, reducing manual resume-processing effort by an estimated 80%.

projects.title: DocMind
projects.stack: Python, LangChain, Mistral AI, ChromaDB, Streamlit
bullets: Created a document question-answering application that processes PDF and TXT files and generates context-aware responses through retrieval-augmented generation.
Orchestrated a semantic retrieval pipeline with LangChain, Mistral AI embeddings, ChromaDB, and Maximal Marginal Relevance search.
Delivered a Streamlit interface and reduced response latency to under 5 seconds during local testing.
